title: tracking: console list page and shell layout refresh after the 2026-10-15 prototype — parent of #12423, #12427, #12440 and #12429, with the items not yet carded
body:
Filing gate ④ (a coordination node: one parent, its child cards listed below) on the maintainer's instruction, gate ③ (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill), verbatim: 「这些任务都是你处理吗？ 是否建议开专题卡」 and, on the seat's recommendation of a `tracking` parent, 「同意专题卡」. The design every child follows is the maintainer-approved prototype at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f (private to the maintainer; artboards: the 1440 main board, the 1024 laptop board with the collapsed icon rail, the 390 phone board that keeps today's phone shape). The maintainer's framing of the whole, verbatim: 「我关心的是平台整体界面的布局优化」 and 「crm 本身的元数据不重要，我关心的还是平台的基础能力」 — every child changes `@object-ui/*` platform behaviour; none touches HotCRM metadata.

**Reader who acts:** nobody on this card itself — it is not dispatchable and carries no `pm:queue`. The `domain:ui` lane, seat 3 (this session, seat post #9800) files and dispatches each child, one dev at a time, and keeps the checklist below current at each round boundary. The maintainer adds follow-ups as comments here; the seat turns each into a child card.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T07:25Z): "tracking parent card console list page shell layout sidebar favorites toolbar Display prototype" → 37 total, top 8 read: the four children (#12440, #12423, #12429, #12427) and four unrelated closed cards (#12211 browser-pass list card, #11572 InterfaceListPage projection, #5720 AppSidebar observation, #3946 app-shell.mdx). No open or closed parent for this prototype. None is this card.

## What the prototype changes, and where each piece lives

The list page on a 1440 px desktop spent about 290 px of chrome before its first row and offered up to twelve toolbar controls at once; the sidebar had two "keep this handy" controls that landed in different places, and its collapse toggle sat at the bottom-left of a long navigation. The prototype's shape: four toolbar controls (Filter · Sort · Display · Search) with everything else inside Display; saved-view tabs sized to the width, on the same row as those controls; one leading cell per grid row (number, checkbox on hover); a one-row page header; one Favorites section at the top of the sidebar fed by a hover ⋯ menu on each item and by the page's overflow menu; the collapse toggle in the app bar's left slot at every width; the phone shape unchanged.

## Children (parallel where the files allow; the merge queue serializes the landings)

- [x] #12423 — list page: the Display popover, width-fitted view tabs, the leading cell, the one-row header. MERGED 2026-10-15T07:29Z as `a2225f9` (PR #12436; ACCEPT + contract review PASS on head `4ba299c`).
- [ ] #12427 — Favorites: the sidebar's bottom Favorites group merges into the top section (named Favorites, 收藏); every sidebar item gets a hover ⋯ menu (favorite, open in new tab, copy link, Design for metadata authors); the page-header star becomes an overflow entry. Dispatched 2026-10-15T06:55Z; round 2 resumed 2026-10-15T07:27Z on the seat's scope note (surface extended to `@object-ui/layout`'s `NavigationRenderer.tsx`); draft PR #12443 (Part of) carries the first piece.
- [ ] #12440 — the saved-view tab strip and the four controls share one row (`ListView` takes a leading toolbar slot as a host prop; the console passes `ViewTabBar` into it). `pm:queue`, p1; runs in parallel with PR #12443 (same `ObjectView.tsx`, different regions; the second to land merges `main` again).
- [ ] #12429 — the sidebar collapse toggle moves from the sidebar footer to the app bar's left slot at every width. `pm:queue`, p1; runs in parallel with PR #12443 (same `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, different regions; the second to land merges `main` again).
- [ ] #12457 — docs: the three artboard PNGs and the targets table land under `docs/design/console-layout-2026-10-15/` so GitHub renders the boards and every dev and seat reviews against the same picture. `pm:queue`, p1, blocks nothing.

## In the prototype, not yet carded (the maintainer decides; a comment here files each)

1. The object breadcrumb row in the app bar: the prototype draws no breadcrumb above the page header. Named out of scope on #12423; a card if wanted.
2. `list_toolbar` metadata actions (Import and the like) moving from the page header into the selection bar when rows are selected. Named out of scope on #12423; a card if wanted.
3. The 1024 px laptop board's collapsed icon rail is #12429's acceptance, not a card of its own.
4. Per-user persistence of Display settings (density, hidden fields, row numbers) is #12418, an existing card outside this parent; #12423 persists nothing new by design.

## How this parent is kept

The checklist above is the only state on this card; the seat ticks a child when its PR is MERGED and adds a line with the merge commit. Child cards carry `Blocked-by:` lines to each other, not to this parent. Sub-issue links are not written: the fleet-write relay's op table has no sub-issue op and the seat writes GitHub through that relay only, so the task-list references above are the parent–child relation GitHub shows ("tracked by").

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's instruction quoted above.

## Design reference (added 2026-10-15T08:12Z on the maintainer's question 「如何确保车道能严格按照你的设计开发」)

The visual target lives in one page, readable by every session of this account and shareable by the maintainer from its Share menu: https://claude.ai/artifact/JCzrzHxTxzD4EEKCTtDaNA — the three artboards rendered to PNG (`main-1440.png`, `laptop-1024.png`, `phone-390.png`, fetchable as the page's files), a targets table per child card, the designer's notes verbatim, and the acceptance protocol. The interactive prototype stays at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f. Text beats picture: a child card's acceptance list is the spec a dev builds and a seat reviews against; the images show the shape; where they disagree the card wins and gets fixed.

Pixel facts on the main board (1440 px, Leads list, admin): chrome before the first data row ≈ 183 px (app bar 48, page header 52, view row 47, table header 36); the console on `main` after #12436 measures ≈ 242 because the tab row and the toolbar are still two rows (#12440 closes that gap, target first row y ≤ 200). At 1024 the sidebar is a 56 px icon rail and 4 tabs show with "4 more". At 390 only the view row changes (a current-view picker, icon-only controls); the phone shape is otherwise today's.

How a landing seat proves a child matches: its `## 席位核对` carries browser readings at 1440 / 1024 / 390 against the HotCRM demo (first-row y, the toolbar's control list by test id, the folded tab count), compared with the targets table. How the maintainer accepts after merge: three screenshots of the merged console beside the three PNGs, taken by the session the maintainer designates; differences come back here as comments and become child cards.

Platform items the boards show that no child card asks for yet (each becomes a card on the maintainer's word here): the app bar's object breadcrumb goes and the Preview badge moves beside the app name; a bulk action bar floats at the bottom when rows are selected; the desktop table scrolls inside the page with a sticky header; a right-edge scroll shadow on the 1024 table; Export and Refresh placement (the prototype's page ⋯ menu vs #12436's Display footer, accepted as is).

Handover: a `domain:ui` PM named by the maintainer takes this parent over; the filing session lands #12427 (PR #12443), returns #12440 and #12429 to `pm:queue` at `priority:p1` in that landing stroke, then clocks out of seat 3 with the handover brief on the seat post.
